newsitem.title: USA: IMF Thai package to include bank measures--Summers.
newsitem.headline: IMF Thai package to include bank measures--Summers.

text.p: A reform program being negotiated between Thailand and the International Monetary Fund will include measures to improve the health and openness of the financial system, a senior Treasury official said on Tuesday.

"We expect that a substantial part of the IMF program will be a set of conditions to address the health of the financial system including measures to promote openness and transparency," Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers told a congressional group on Tuesday.

Thailand won $16 billion in international loans on Monday to ease its financial problems. The package, 50 percent funded by Japan and the IMF, is underpinned by a broad IMF-sponsored reform package expected to be signed next week.
